Q5217.reason: CIF includes cost, insurance, and freight, so loading charges are covered and the added term likely fails under UCC 2-207.

Q6156.reason: Former testimony requires opportunity and similar motive to cross-examine on the same issue, which the company lacked regarding the pilot's liability issue.

Q8413.reason: In Al-Adsani, the ECtHR held that state immunity did not violate the right to a fair trial, so immunity prevailed.
